WITH filtered_data AS (
  SELECT t.telescregistry, t.observstation, t.bandusagepct, o.weathprofile
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    weathprofile,
    AVG(CAST(bandusagepct AS FLOAT)) as avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM filtered_data
  GROUP BY observstation, weathprofile
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_bandwidth) as final_avg_bandwidth,
  AVG(CAST(telescope_count AS FLOAT)) as final_avg_count
FROM group_stats
